newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador oil workers may strike to back minister.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador oil workers may strike to back minister.

text.p: Ecuador's oil and electricity workers threatened to go on strike if Congress impeaches Energy Minister Raul Baca.
"If the trial against minister Baca is opened, oil workers are going on strike," FETRAPEC oil workers union leader Ivan Narvaez was quoted as saying Tuesday by the newspaper Hoy.
The paper said electricity workers would also join the protest to defend Baca, who is considered "an honest man and the only chance workers have to protect these sectors against privatizations."
The stand of Ecuador's two key unions is in sharp contrast to their frequent walk-outs to press for the resignation of energy ministers.
But Narvaez heaped praise on Baca and said the impeachment was "a maneuver of the (opposition) Social Christian party to take (state oil firm) Petroecuador by storm."
The congressional opposition blames Baca for the latest rise in electricity tarifs. A decision on their impeachment motion is expected within two weeks.
